description: law-bench contract toolset: tag-driven contract generation (52 tools) — generate/evaluate Chinese contracts against rubrics, manage clauses, rubrics, prompts and tags, run self-heal pipelines, RAG clause search, and artifact download. Backend serves streamable MCP over HTTP.

tools.name: agent_run_get
tools.description:
Get one ``agent_runs`` row (full) by id.

Returns ``{...}`` with all columns, or ``None`` if absent.

tools.name: agent_run_list
tools.description:
List recent ``agent_runs`` rows (summary fields only).

Returns ``[{id, thread_id, contract_type, task_desc, total_slots,
human_filled_slots, eval_run_id, total_duration, created_at}]``.

tools.name: agent_run_store
tools.description:
Store an agent run's metrics into the ``agent_runs`` table.

This is called by the review-agent at the end of a run to persist all
instrumentation data: timing, token usage, reviewer suggestions, slot
coverage, evaluation linkage.

tools.name: auto_reject_pipeline_run
tools.description:
Generate, fill, evaluate, self-heal, then auto-apply clause rejections.

Drives a LangGraph: ``generate -> fill -> evaluate -> check -> (improve) ->
store -> learn``. The ``learn`` node aggregates ``clause_review``
recommendations from the current run **and** recent historical runs; any
**custom** clause reaching the rejection threshold
(``AUTO_REJECT_THRESHOLD``, default 3) is automatically marked ``rejected``
via ``bulk_review`` so it drops out of future assembly. Base/tagged clauses
are never touched.

tools.name: clause_delete
tools.description: Delete one clause by id.

tools.name: clause_get
tools.description: Fetch one clause by id (any source: base / tagged / custom).

tools.name: clause_list
tools.description: List clauses from the ``clauses`` table, filtered and ordered.

tools.name: clause_review
tools.description:
Set ALL of a clause's tag dims to one review status (bulk approve/reject).

A clause is assembly-ready only when every tag dim is ``"approved"``; setting
any dim to ``"rejected"`` (or ``"pending"``) excludes it from assembly, so a
thin custom clause can be retired without deleting it (re-approve later to
restore it).

tools.name: clause_update
tools.description:
Update a clause's body / section / tags by id; re-derives dependent fields.

Only the parameters you pass are written; omitted fields keep their current
value. ``body_hash`` / ``slot_instructions`` / ``law_refs`` are re-derived
from the (possibly edited) body. The clause is marked ``manual=true`` so a
later re-extraction won't overwrite the edit. Raises a tool error for an
unknown id.

tools.name: compare_get
tools.description: Fetch the full grouped result for one compare.

tools.name: compare_list
tools.description:
List recent compare runs (compare-level fields only), newest first.

Returns ``[{id, label, contract_type, rubric_name, task_desc, gen_mode,
n_drafts, created_at}]``.

tools.name: compare_matrix
tools.description:
Fetch a compare's criteria x prompts matrix in one call.

Equivalent to ``build_matrix(get_compare(compare_id))``. Cells are binary
verdicts when ``n_drafts == 1`` and ``k/N`` pass-rates when ``n_drafts > 1``.

tools.name: compare_run
tools.description:
Draft + evaluate each named prompt against ``rubric_name``; persist grouped.

For each prompt name, resolves the prompt record, generates ``n_drafts``
drafts (drafter-only mode: one direct DRAFTER-model call per draft), judges
each against the rubric, and persists the runs under one ``compare_runs``
row.

tools.name: contract_content
tools.description: Return assembled contract content (markdown/JSON) without file I/O.

tools.name: contract_download
tools.description:
Fetch a stored contract artifact's metadata + download URL(s).

Does NOT regenerate - it reads the previously-stored ``contract_artifacts``
row. The agent fetches the file bytes over HTTP from the returned URL.

tools.name: contract_evaluate
tools.description: Evaluate a drafted contract against a named rubric (LLM-judge).

tools.name: contract_generate
tools.description:
Generate a contract deliverable (DOCX/PDF) for a contract class.

By default renders the registered 母版 template (skeleton). When ``stance``
and/or a ``tags`` dict carrying ``stance`` / ``scenario`` is supplied,
assembles base + tagged + custom clauses and filters the custom-clause
selection by the given stance (``pro_a`` / ``pro_b`` / ``balanced``) and the
tagged selection by scenario (业务场景, e.g. 农产品买卖 / 驾校培训 /
住宅租赁). ``region`` / ``province`` keys are not recognized (province was
retired in favor of ``scenario``).

tools.name: contract_generate_batch
tools.description: Generate multiple contracts in parallel across different tag combinations.

tools.name: contract_generate_stored
tools.description:
Generate a contract deliverable (DOCX/PDF), upload it to MinIO, and record
a ``contract_artifacts`` row so it can be re-downloaded without regenerating.

Content-addressed by ``md5(body_text)``: identical inputs (same
``contract_type`` + ``scenario`` + ``stance`` + ``custom_clause_ids``) reuse
the same artifact (``reused: true``); missing formats are filled in.

tools.name: contract_type_catalog
tools.description: List all supported contract types with metadata.

tools.name: criterion_add
tools.description: Append a criterion to a local rubric at the next ordinal.

tools.name: criterion_delete
tools.description: Delete a criterion from a local rubric and renumber the survivors.

tools.name: criterion_reorder
tools.description: Reassign criterion ``ordinal`` to match the given order.

tools.name: criterion_update
tools.description: Update a criterion's name, description, and guidance (ordinal untouched).

tools.name: law_info
tools.description: Fetch both sources' survey content for a contract type.

tools.name: law_references
tools.description:
Aggregate the unique laws referenced across every law_info survey.

Runs :func:`src.eval.legal_refs.extract_references` over
:func:`src.eval.law_info.all_law_info`. Returns a list of
``{name, category, category_zh, contract_types, sources, occurrences}``
sorted by category then name. Read-only.

tools.name: law_types
tools.description:
List contract types that have at least one law_info survey row.

Returns ``[{key, zh_name, sources}]`` ordered by contract type, where
``sources`` lists the sources present for that type (e.g.
``["doubao", "deepseek"]``).

tools.name: pipeline_get
tools.description: Fetch one pipeline run + its linked eval run's per-criterion verdicts.

tools.name: pipeline_list
tools.description:
List recent pipeline runs (most recent first).

Returns ``[{id, contract_type, stance, rubric_name, task_desc, score,
max_score, n_passed, n_criteria, all_pass, iteration, eval_run_id,
fill_temperature, created_at}]``.

tools.name: prompt_create
tools.description: Create a local prompt (``source = 'local'``).

tools.name: prompt_delete
tools.description: Delete a prompt (no child table, nothing cascades).

tools.name: prompt_get
tools.description: Fetch a prompt's full record (including ``content``), by name.

tools.name: prompt_list
tools.description:
List all generation prompts (without the content body).

Returns ``[{id, name, contract_type, purpose, source, prompt_type,
description, created_at}]``.

tools.name: prompt_update
tools.description: Update a prompt's full record.

tools.name: rubric_create
tools.description: Create a local rubric (``source = 'local'``) with optional criteria.

tools.name: rubric_delete
tools.description: Delete a local rubric; its criteria cascade via FK ON DELETE CASCADE.

tools.name: rubric_get
tools.description: Fetch a rubric's metadata and ordered criteria, by name.

tools.name: rubric_list
tools.description: List available evaluation rubrics.

tools.name: rubric_update
tools.description: Update a local rubric's name, context, and description (criteria untouched).

tools.name: run_draft
tools.description: Lazily fetch a single run's ``draft_text`` (verified to belong to the compare).

tools.name: run_get
tools.description:
Fetch a single evaluation run's run-level fields and its per-criterion verdicts.

The counterpart to ``run_list`` (which returns run-level fields only).

tools.name: run_list
tools.description: List recent evaluation runs (most recent first).

tools.name: search_clauses
tools.description: Retrieve ranked clause chunks for a natural-language query.

tools.name: self_heal_pipeline_run
tools.description:
Generate, fill, evaluate, and self-heal a contract in one pipeline run.

Drives a LangGraph: ``generate -> fill -> evaluate -> check -> (improve) ->
store``. The ``improve`` node excludes thin custom clauses **per run** (via
``custom_clause_ids``) and records ``clause_review`` recommendations without
executing them. The best-scoring iteration is persisted.

**Concurrency:** Safe to run in parallel (read-only on clauses table).

tools.name: tag_combinations_list
tools.description:
Enumerate all valid tag combinations for a contract type.

Generates Cartesian product of all tag dimensions (excluding ``source``)
with optional clause availability metadata. Warns if combinations exceed
1000 due to combinatorial explosion risk.

tools.name: tag_iteration_apply
tools.description:
Apply approved tag changes with rollback protection.

Takes a list of approved suggestions from ``tag_iteration_suggest`` and
applies the tag modifications. Then re-evaluates the contract to verify
the changes improved the score. If the score decreased, automatically
rolls back to the original tags.

**Concurrency:** Uses pg_advisory_lock to prevent concurrent modifications.
Only one ``tag_iteration_apply`` can run at a time.

tools.name: tag_iteration_suggest
tools.description:
Analyze failing clauses and suggest tag modifications.

Drives a LangGraph: ``generate -> fill -> evaluate -> check -> (improve) ->
store -> suggest_retag``. The ``suggest_retag`` node uses LLM to analyze
clauses that caused evaluation failures and suggests tag modifications
(scenario, stance, strength, etc.) that might improve future evaluations.

**Concurrency:** Safe to run in parallel (read-only on clauses table).

tools.name: tag_validate
tools.description:
Validate a tag dict against the controlled vocabulary.

Returns the cleaned dict: unknown keys are dropped, and ``scenario`` plus
free-form dims are kept (any non-empty value). For a controlled dim with an
invalid value, raises a tool error naming the dim, the bad value, and the
allowed set.

tools.name: tag_vocab_list
tools.description:
List the merged flat tag vocabulary for a contract type.

Returns ``{dim: [allowed values]}`` for every dimension valid for the type:
universal starter dims (``stance`` / ``strength`` / ``risk`` / ``mandatory``)
merged with the type-specific dims from the ``tag_dims`` table. When
``contract_type`` is ``None``, returns only the universal dims.

tools.name: task_failed_items
tools.description:
取某任务的失败/未完成条目，供分项重试。

pipeline 家族在全通过时返回空列表；未全通过时返回一条说明（含 iteration，
调用方据此判断是否要换 rubric 重跑而不是重跑同一条）。batch 家族无法从
句柄反推条目，返回空列表——请按 `task_status` 的 error 说明处理。

tools.name: task_status
tools.description:
按任务句柄查状态与结果（统一了 pipeline 与 batch 两个家族）。

`self_heal_pipeline_run` 返回 `pipeline_run_id`（数字），
`contract_generate_batch` 返回 `trace_id`（`trace-` 前缀）。此前调用方
拿到一个 id 要自己知道该去哪张表查——一个没有查询路径的句柄等于没有句柄。

Returns ``{handle, kind, found, status, progress, counts, result?, error?}``。

**状态如实**：pipeline 家族跑完即落库，故库里查到就是 completed、查不到
就是 not_found；batch 家族的 trace_id 只是日志关联键、不落条目表，故
报 `unknown_not_persisted` 并说明"逐条结果只在调用返回里"。这里刻意不
编造 running/interrupted——那会让调用方对着一个假的进度条干等。

tools.name: type_metadata
tools.description: Get detailed metadata for a single contract type.

tools.name: validation_check
tools.description: Evaluate a drafted contract against legal hard-limit constraints.

tools.name: validation_list
tools.description: List stored validation constraints for a contract type.
